tier-base-reference · semantic-color-pal.why: semantic-color-palette.json is named as the semantic tier and its tokens are role aliases of the hue palette in color-palette.json (accent-color-100 → {blue-100}, accent-subtle-background-color-default → {accent-color-200}); DTsanity read it as base from the word "palette" in the file name, ignoring "semantic".

tier-hardcoded · color-aliases.json · ba.why: Over half of the 33 places are opacity-0 … opacity-1000 (0, 0.02 … 1), a numbered scale of raw values, i.e. a base scale that happens to live in color-aliases.json; DTsanity read them as semantic from the file name "aliases". The rest (drop-shadow-*-color, background-opacity-*) are a minority of the finding.
